videos.title: The CIA Protocol: How to Train Your Brain for Remote Viewing
videos.verdict_note: [live analysis, metadata-only] Interview-style science-adjacent content on CIA remote viewing; originality of claims can't be judged from metadata alone.

videos.title: Joe McMoneagle - CIA's Project Stargate | SRS #95
videos.verdict_note: [live analysis, metadata-only] Long-form first-person interview with a named Stargate remote viewer; primary-source testimony rather than repackaged clips.

videos.title: The Mystery of PROJECT STARGATE : CIA’s Secret Remote Viewing Program
videos.verdict_note: [live analysis, metadata-only] Documentary-style recap of widely covered declassified Stargate material; no new sources indicated in metadata.

videos.title: Uncovering the CIA's Secret Weapon: Psychic Spies
videos.verdict_note: [live analysis, metadata-only] Framing of CIA 'psychic spies' as a secret weapon retells the well-covered Stargate story; title promises uncovering already-public files.

videos.title: Inside Project Stargate: Government Remote Viewing and the Secrets of the Spirit Realm
videos.verdict_note: [live analysis, metadata-only] Retells the familiar declassified Stargate remote-viewing story, adding a spiritual/'spirit realm' framing rather than new evidence.
